content.title: ‘The Masked Singer’ reveals Stingray, 14 Karat Carrot in double elimination; here’s who they are
content.text: Published March 18, 2026 6:17pm MST LOS ANGELES - On Wednesday night’s "Star Trek Night" on "The Masked Singer," two contestants were beamed out of the competition in a double elimination. On the latest episode, Stingray, Cat Witch, 14 Karat Carrot and Galaxy Girl fought to secure a place in the semi-finals. But in the end, both 14 Karat Carrot and Stingray were sent home. Who is 14 Karat Carrot on ‘The Masked Singer’? Big picture view: Greg Mathis, an Emmy award-winning judge, was the first celebrity to be unmasked on Wednesday’s episode of the FOX singing reality competition. What they're saying: "In Detroit, I used to sit outside or sing outside of Motown, me and my buddies, hoping that we’d get discovered," the 65-year-old told the audience following his reveal. "Here I am performing on stage in front of millions of viewers and you beautiful folks here. I’ve achieved my dreams." Robin Thicke was the only panelist able to accurately predict that Mathis was under the mask. 14 Karat Carrot and Stingray perform on "The Masked Singer." (Credit: Michael Becker/FOX) "It was the justice and then finally the gavel, I was just like ‘this has to be him,’" Thicke told Mathis. Mathis was born in Detroit, Michigan. He is a producer and actor, most notably known for the television series "Judge Mathis", which ran for more than two decades. Who is Stingray on ‘The Masked Singer’? Big picture view: Evan Ross, an actor and musician, was the second celebrity to be revealed. What they're saying: "It’s been a nice experience for me, because I didn’t have to deal with the idea of preconception of anything. So it’s been like very fun," he told the audience. The 37-year-old is also the son of Motown legend and actress Diana Ross. "I think she’ll enjoy it," Ross said of his mom watching his performance. "She’s been trying to make me sing for a long time." Next week on ‘The Masked Singer’ What's next: This means Cat Witch, Galaxy Girl, Picasso, Pangolin and Crane will move on to the semi-finals. Next week, the competition will be fierce with all the celebrities competing to stay in the game and make it to the finale.
